seed_pairing_note: The standardized 50 and 100 ppm sensitivity runs pair trial seeds by target. Both levels use the same deterministic seed, with noise index fixed at 0 and seed derivation based on master seed, target index, and trial index. This pairing note is separate from the expected-noise input, which stores one PandExo-derived noise level per target.
